parameters.description:
`msg-to-pushdeer` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your PushDeer destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise) — the open-source notification library — or a native gateway transformation, both free and driven entirely by your own stored credentials. Paid variants ($0.001 per message) deliver to additional PushDeer destinations bound per enrollment.
parameters.gateway_body_template: text={* _escape_json((_body.title or "")..(((_body.title or "")~="" and (_body.body or "")~="") and "\n" or "")..(_body.body or "")) *}&type=text&desp=UnitySVC
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment PushDeer destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your PushDeer pushkey
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own PushDeer destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

pushkey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's PushDeer pushkey
